summary: When enabled, the app retries recovery of unavailable Pi panes with one task per shell; Axod owns the actual idle-only, non-forcing recovery and result reconciliation.
trigger: Session snapshots show an unavailable Pi pane and automatic recovery preference is enabled.

steps.action: Schedule at most one retry loop per unavailable Pi shell and stop it when preference is disabled, shell disappears, or shell recovers.
Negotiate support and request the auto-restart RPC; unsupported daemon retries after 30 seconds and transient errors use exponential backoff up to 30 seconds.
Recover the unavailable pane only under automatic idle-only, non-forcing takeover policy; verify pane/runtime reservation before committing recovered process.
Validate returned session identity and shell availability, then update the local catalog.
